customisationOptions.option: Add entrance fees to all three sites
customisationOptions.source: The tour comes in three tiers, so you only pay for what you want: a Base package (private vehicle, guide, water, and all logistics); Base + Entrance Fees (the same, plus entry to all three sites); and Base + Entrance Fees & Lunch (those entrance fees plus a midday meal).

customisationOptions.option: Add a midday lunch with the entrance fees

customisationOptions.option: Sequence the day to dodge Karnak's midday heat
customisationOptions.source: The concierge can sequence the day to dodge the midday heat at Karnak's open courts.

customisationOptions.option: Change the order: more temple or more museum
customisationOptions.source: Because the day is yours, the order and the dwell times bend to your party — more temple, less museum, or the reverse.
